desc:
Roll for rare cars, earn money from your garage, and take your cars racing to earn more.

🚗 Collect 190+ cars and fill your Car Index.
💰 Park your cars to earn cash, even while you're offline.
🏁 Race and drift on our new tracks for extra money.
⬆️ Level your cars up to 100 to increase their income.
🍀 Upgrade your luck for a better chance at rolling rare cars.

BETA 3.0
• 2 new race tracks
• Chroma Index
• Mobile Performance
• Bug fixes

Thanks for playing! Leave a like and favorite if you're enjoying the game.
